'''Austin Sheppard''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 5th (I think) at [[January 2001 Smyrna tournament (13 January)]] on 13 January 2001, according to James McNash's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1614">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-13-smryna-georgia-01-13-01d1614/ smryna-georgia-01-13-01], DeckTech (James "kmcnash" McNash, 13 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-13-smryna-georgia-01-13-01d1614/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
